summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync currency handling refactor) wrote ledger amounts 100x the order amounts.
recommended: Fix the currency/amount scaling bug in v1.4 and add a ledger-vs-order amount test before redeploying.

events.text: v1.4 is corrupting the ledger (amounts ×100). I'll roll back first.

All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
